about: Fixed sentences for the hearing suite, spoken by the Mac's built-in `say` voices (SYNTHETIC, CLEAN speech: not real older voices, no background noise, no accent or hesitation) and heard by Meta Transcribe. Written by the Maya team; no real people. terms = key words that must survive (each entry lists acceptable spellings). wer: false means the sentence has numbers or amounts, whose written form varies, so it is scored on its key terms only.

sentences.text: Good morning Maya, I am just having my tea and looking at the garden.
My granddaughter Priya is coming to visit for the weekend.
My son Ravi lives in Chicago and he rings me every Sunday.
I would like a cup of ginger tea and a slice of toast please.
My knee is a bit sore on the stairs today but it is not too bad.
I have a doctor appointment next Thursday at the surgery.
Please tell my family that I called and that I am feeling fine.
I do not want to live alone and I feel very lonely in the evenings.
Can you remind me to take my tablets after lunch.
The roses are finished and the petals are all over the path.
A man phoned and told me to buy gift cards or I would be arrested.
A lady rang from my bank and asked me to read out the code from my text message.
Someone wanted my Medicare number and my date of birth over the phone.
He said I must not tell my son and that I have to pay by bank transfer today.
They told me to install a program so they could see my computer screen.
I got a message saying I have won a prize but I have to pay a fee first.
A parcel could not be delivered and they want my card details to try again.
My account has been locked and I must verify my details at once.
The tax office says I owe money and a warrant will be issued.
I am on my way to the shop right now to get the vouchers he asked for.
He wants two hundred pounds sent by the end of today.
My telephone number ends in four seven two one.
The refund is for three hundred and fifty dollars they said.
I was born on the third of May nineteen forty eight.
